gauge.name: White Rock Creek at Dallas

impacts.statement: Major flooding will occur along the creek. Fair Oaks Avenue near the bridge will have 2 to 3 feet of water over it, and Merriman Parkway at RP Brooks Park east of Abrams Road will start to flood; the park and playground will have several feet of water over it. Portions of Merriman Parkway west of Abrams will have multiple feet of water over it as well, and the tennis center along that strech of road will be submerged. Moss Park will have major flooding.

Major flooding will occur along the creek. Fair Oaks Avenue near the bridge will start to flood. Portions of Merriman Parkway west of Abrams Road will be flooded, as well as the tennis center on that stretch of road. RP Brooks Park and playground on Merriman Parkway east of Abrams Road will be flooded as well. Moss Park will have major flooding.

Moderate flooding will occur along the creek. Portions of Merriman Parkway west of Abrams Road will flood. The parking lot and soccer fields at Moss Park will be completely flooded with several feet of water, and the Fair Oaks Softball and Baseball Complex near the high school will be flooded.

Minor flooding will occur near the creek. Bike paths in Moss Park downstream of the gage will be flooded, and the soccer fields at Moss Park will begin to flood. Water approaches the Fair Oaks Softball and Baseball Complex near Emmett Conrad High School.
